'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las gshin 'chi bdag nag po'i bskang ba ni/hūm̐/myur mgyogs mthu rtsal thogs med phrin las kyis/

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las gshin 'chi bdag nag po'i bskang ba ni/1$0000300 hūm̐/ myur mgyogs mthu rtsal thogs med phrin las kyis// gdug can dgra dang bdud bgegs pham mdzad pa// gshin rje gshed po'i bka' nyan dam tshig can// bai wa sa twa 'khor bcas dgyes par dgongs// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs gang ba'i// rnam rol ma 'gags phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa// gang bzhed dgyes dgur 'chang bas thugs dam bskang*/ khrag zhag arghaṃ dbang po'i me tog bzhad// gsur chen bdug spos zhun chen sgron me sbar// mkhris pa'i dri chab sha sna'i zhal zas spung*// rkang gling thod rnga bshugs glus thugs dam bskang*// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman// dgra bgegs snying khrag lbu phreng bzhad pa'i mtsho// sha khrag rus pa'i gtor chen ri ltar spung*// mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi'i ro yis thugs dam bskang*// mig sman ltar gnag rta mchog dpa' gtum khyi// brjid pa'i g.yag rgod lug nag rog po'i ra// gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu yi// srog chags rgyan gyis spras pas thugs dam bskang*// gnam lcags thod mkhar drag po'i gzhal med khang*// 'bod pa'i g.yab dar dur khrod drag po'i chas// mda' mdung ral gri go mtshon rmog dang phub// mthun pa'i spyan gzigs tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran rtags rdzas brgyad// srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod par byin brlabs nas// bskang ngo gsol lo nyams chag sos gyur cig /khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i rlung shugs kyis// bstan dgra gdug can tshogs kyi bla srog yid// dbang du sdus la drag po'i phrin las kyis// ma thog myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces pa 'di'ang mdo khams zhe chen dgon gyi mchog sprul padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dgongs bzhed skong phyir o ḍī ya nas gang shar thol byung du smras so/// / dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
